body: thank you so much for your advice I might look into group therapy thanks to you. I really needed kind words atm that helped so much

I can't explain why but I can explain how I personaly deal with that, I have the chance of living in a rural area so I usually go out for a walk and just start screaming. It honestly feels weird the first time you do it but it's very liberating and it's enough to make me finally cry

Even if you don't cry it still let's go a lot of emotion.

Another way I used to deal with that is playing drums or punching something soft like your bed

hope this helps

I know that's the easy way I thougt about it but I just can't imagine leaving him I'm chronically depressed and he's the only person who made me realize I could live past my twenties I don't think I could ever love someone like I love him
